args: set -eu; workspace=$PWD; runtime=${AOS_HOME:-$HOME/.aos}/runtime; if [ -n "${AOS_BIN:-}" ]; then aos=$AOS_BIN; elif [ -n "${AOS_BIN_ROOT:-}" ]; then aos=$AOS_BIN_ROOT/aos; elif [ -x "${AOS_HOME:-$HOME/.aos}/bin/aos" ]; then aos=${AOS_HOME:-$HOME/.aos}/bin/aos; else aos=$(command -v aos); fi; cd "$runtime"; if [ "${AOS_MCP_MODE:-gateway}" = per-session ]; then exec "$aos" --principal codex-code mcp serve --workspace "$workspace" --request-timeout 1d5m; fi; exec "$aos" --principal codex-code mcp attach --workspace "$workspace"
